description: a grant minted on a session no run reports under, then Close: the held grant.mint is emitted filed under no run (weft.run.id absent), held true, keyed by weft.session.id and the public id; indexed by its session alone (session_events; SQLite stores it nowhere else, ClickHouse in otel_logs), read back through SessionEvents; then the session reopened over hand-appended messages, compacted and closed with no run: its compaction marker emitted the same way (no weft.run.id, held true in its body, keyed by the session); no run row
